import copy,fcntl,json,sys,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.decision_evidence_transfer import RankedOnline,LINKED_METHOD,evidence_proposals,member_program_payload
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import ROOT,read,sha,now,points
from legal_skill_guard.learning.member_learning import paired_effect
from legal_skill_guard.learning.executable_features import validate_member_programs
from legal_skill_guard.experiment.storage import RunStore
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha

class FinalComponentReadout(RankedOnline):
    def teacher_call(self,*args,**kwargs):
        raise AssertionError("Prespecified component attribution has no teacher, learning or admission")

    def fit_prefix(self,*args,**kwargs):
        raise AssertionError("Components share the actual existing final ordinary tool without a new fit")

    def execute(self):
        assert self.cfg["method"]==LINKED_METHOD
        assert self.cfg["study_kind"]=="prespecified_final_B4_component_readout"
        assert len(self.documents)==8 and len(self.past)==154
        plan=read(ROOT/self.cfg["prespecified_plan"])
        assert [r["id"] for r in self.documents]==plan["cohort_ids"]
        assert plan["planned_new_native_teacher_CPUfits"]==[16,0,0]
        reference=ROOT/self.cfg["reference_run"]
        terminal=read(ROOT/self.cfg["reference_terminal_preservation"])
        assert terminal["state"]=="terminal_results_preserved" and terminal["actual_complete_record_exists"]
        assert sha(terminal["archive"])==sha(terminal["rootdisk_copy"])==terminal["archive_sha256"]
        last=read(reference/"completion.json")
        assert last["final_bank"]==self.parent
        ordinary=read(reference/"ordinary_controls/after_b3.json")
        assert ordinary["sha256"]==self.manifest["pickle_sha256"]
        assert ordinary["source_ids"]==self.prefix_ids
        assert last["actual_new_native_teacher_CPUfits"]==[160,6,3]
        self.current_batch=4
        self.check();self.validate_runtime_bank()
        banks={}
        for condition,keep in (("code_only","python_source"),("procedure_only","procedure")):
            other="procedure" if keep=="python_source" else "python_source"
            banks[condition]=[]
            for skill in self.parent:
                if skill["guidance"][keep] is None:
                    continue
                item=copy.deepcopy(skill);item["guidance"][other]=None
                banks[condition].append(item)
            validate_member_programs(banks[condition],self.labels,allow_procedures=True)
        self.record("declaration.json",{"at":now(),"config":self.cfg,"frozen_bindings":self.bindings.copy(),
            "actual_last_full_bank":self.parent,"mechanically_defined_component_banks":banks,
            "not_learning_best_bank_selection_independent_repeat_or_official_TEST":True})
        self.record("publications/initial.json",{"at":now(),"publication":self.parent,
            "not_updated_by_component_study":True,"actual_final_ordinary_source_ids":self.prefix_ids})
        prepared={}
        comparisons=[]
        for row in self.documents:
            proposed=evidence_proposals(self.model,row,self.labels)
            full=read(reference/f"inputs/b4_prequential/{row['id']}/skills.json")
            empty=read(reference/f"inputs/b4_prequential/{row['id']}/joint_empty.json")
            for condition in banks:
                messages,schema,trace=member_program_payload(row,self.labels,proposed,
                    self.cfg["bundled_solver_system"],banks[condition],allow_procedures=True)
                source=full if condition=="code_only" else empty
                assert messages[0]==source["messages"][0] and schema==source["schema"]
                expected=json.loads(source["messages"][1]["content"])
                expected["learned_legal_procedures"]=([] if condition=="code_only" else
                    [{"hypothesis_ids":s["hypothesis_ids"],"procedure":s["guidance"]["procedure"]} for s in banks[condition]])
                assert messages[1]["content"]==json.dumps(expected,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":"))
                prepared[(row["id"],condition)]=(messages,schema,trace)
                comparisons.append({"document_id":row["id"],"condition":condition,
                    "exact_native_input_equivalence_to_declared_reference_intervention":True})
        self.record("all8_controlled_input_equivalence_before_generation.json",{"at":now(),
            "all16_condition_inputs":comparisons,"no_new_native_teacher_generation":True})
        for index,row in enumerate(self.documents):
            order=("code_only","procedure_only") if index%2==0 else ("procedure_only","code_only")
            for condition in order:
                self.phase="b4_component_"+condition
                self.bank=copy.deepcopy(banks[condition])
                messages,schema,trace=prepared[(row["id"],condition)]
                self.record(f"source_executions/{self.phase}/{row['id']}/skills.json",trace)
                self.record_program_cost(trace["actual_member_program_executions"],"actual_component_native_input")
                self.logical(row,"skills",self.generate(row,"skills",messages,schema))
        self.bank=copy.deepcopy(self.parent)
        assert len(self.native)==16 and not self.teachers and not self.fit_records
        actual=self.score(self.answers);self.units.extend(actual)
        inherited={}
        for condition,arm in (("full_linked_reference","skills"),("empty_reference","joint_empty")):
            units=[read(reference/f"logical_answers/b4_prequential/{r['id']}/{arm}.json") for r in self.documents]
            assert all(u["ordinary_tool_source_ids"]==self.prefix_ids for u in units)
            if arm=="skills":
                assert all(u["bank_sha256"]==csha(self.parent) for u in units)
            inherited[condition]=self.score(units)
        groups={**inherited,**{condition:[u for u in actual if u["stage"]=="b4_component_"+condition] for condition in banks}}
        assert all(len(v)==8 and len({u["document_id"] for u in v})==8 for v in groups.values())
        self.record("inherited_original_comparison_answers.json",{"at":now(),"all16_reused_reference_units":inherited,
            "not_new_or_independent_generations":True})
        effects={}
        for i,(a,b) in enumerate((("empty_reference","full_linked_reference"),("empty_reference","code_only"),
            ("empty_reference","procedure_only"),("code_only","full_linked_reference"),("procedure_only","full_linked_reference"))):
            effects[b+"_minus_"+a]=paired_effect(groups[a],groups[b],seed=2026101860+i,replicates=5000)
        result={"at":now(),"run_id":self.run_id,"metrics":{k:points(v) for k,v in groups.items()},
            "descriptive_paired_source_effects":effects,"actual_new_native_teacher_CPUfits":[16,0,0],
            "reused_native_reference_answers":16,"source_episode_actual_native_teacher_CPUfits":last["actual_new_native_teacher_CPUfits"],
            "source_episode_prior130_training_cost_not_zero_or_recovered_here":True,
            "actual_source_program_CPU_costs":self.program_cost,"units":actual,"fixed_full_bank":self.parent,
            "mechanically_defined_component_banks":banks,
            "no_published_bank_change_gate_retry_answer_repair_or_new_labels":True,
            "previously_evaluated_development_B4_not_unseen_official_TEST_or_independent_learning":True}
        self.record("completion.json",result)
        RunStore.atomic_json(self.out/"progress.json",{"at":now(),"state":"completed","run_id":self.run_id,
            "completed_native_calls":16,"completed_teacher_calls":0,"metrics":result["metrics"]})
        print(json.dumps({"completed":self.run_id,"metrics":result["metrics"]}),flush=True)

with (ROOT/"artifacts/gpu_generation.lock").open("a+") as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    study=FinalComponentReadout(Path(sys.argv[1]))
    try:
        study.execute()
    except BaseException as error:
        failure={"at":now(),"state":"failed","error":repr(error),"traceback":traceback.format_exc(),
            "actual_new_native_teacher_calls":[len(study.native),len(study.teachers)],
            "no_retry_answer_repair_bank_selection_or_main_run_mutation":True}
        study.record("failure.json",failure)
        RunStore.atomic_json(study.out/"progress.json",failure)
        raise
